  Pursuant to India na Code chapte r 8 -1-26, the Pipeline Safety Division (“Division”)  of 
the Indiana Utility Regulatory Commission  (“Commission”) investigates excava tion damage 
cases and makes findings violations of said chapter. Upon review of those findings, the Indiana 
Underground Plant  Protection Advisory Committee (“Advisory Committee”) reviews those 
findings and recommends civil penalties in each case.   
 
Attached to this order are the cases received , with Division findings of violations and 
Advisory Committee recommendations, that are ripe for Commission action.   
 
The Commission hereby UPHOLDS the findings of violations by the Division and 
APPROVES the recommendations of the Advisory Committee as listed on the attached  pages. 
The Office of General Counsel is directed to prepare and send notice to the parties advising them 
of the determination. 
 
Civil penalties approved by the Commission are due within 90 days of the date of this 
Order unless payment arrangements are made with the Commission’s Office of General Counsel.   
 
Trainings approved by the Commission must be completed no later than 90 days from the 
date of this Order unless o therwise agreed in writing by the Commission’s O ffice of General 
Counsel for good cause shown . Failure to complete the training r esults in the alternative civil 
penalty noted in the attached recommendation becoming due.

cd /tmp/r2run-7zu7gub6/data/text; cat > $TMPDIR/a.py <<'E'
import re,glob,collections
U=["centerpoint","northern indiana public service","nipsco","citizens gas","citizens energy","vectren","indiana american water","ohio valley gas","american electric power","duke energy","community natural gas","midwest natural gas","frontier communications"]
n=0;tot=0;c=collections.Counter();bad=0
for f in glob.glob('*.txt'):
    t=open(f).read()
    pages=t.split('=== page')
    for p in pages:
        m=re.search(r'^\s*Respondent:[ \t]*(.*)$',p,re.M)
        if not m: continue
        o=re.search(r'^\s*Other Party:[ \t]*(.*)$',p,re.M)
        tot+=1
        r=m.group(1).strip().lower()
        if not o: bad+=1;print(f,r);continue
        if not r.startswith(tuple(U)):
            n+=1;c[o.group(1).strip().lower()]+=1
print(tot,n,bad);
for k,v in c.most_common(6):print(k,v,round(100*v/n,2))
E
python3 -I $TMPDIR/a.py

- **Scope:** I parsed all 58 orders in the text files. They hold 9,963 cases, and 7,250 of those have a non-utility respondent under your prefix list.
- **Matching:** I counted exact text after ignoring case and surrounding spaces, so "NIPSCO" and "Northern Indiana Public Service Company" count as different names.
- **Runners-up:**
  - CenterPoint Energy Indiana: 2,427 cases (33.5%).
  - Citizens Gas: 902 cases (12.4%).
- **Blank other-party lines:** 214 cases (3.0%) have an empty "Other Party" value on the line. That is probably a name wrapped onto the next line, and I didn't check. Even if all 214 belonged to the leader, the top name and its rank wouldn't change, but the percentage would shift slightly.
- **Date range:** I didn't filter on order date. The filenames look like they all fall in 2021–2025, which matches your 58 orders.
